items.text: Kobe eroet loka ateker naka idwe luka Yuda kwape ejaatar ikekiakee ageun koikor loka Edom, kiton amodiŋ naka Sin, kari naka eŋalakimak, atutubet nakosane naka eŋalakimak.
Ageunit eikorukee loka ari naka eŋalakimak katutubet nakosane loka Aŋolol naka Abalaŋ, ageun kagor naitei eŋalakimak:
Kitor ari naka eŋalakimak naedokarere Akurabim, kobei Sin, kitor ari naka eŋalakimak naka Kades-barunea, kiriria Kesiron, kitor Adar, kokudo koKaraka:
Kobe Asimon, kitor aguurut nako Misiri; kosan eikor aŋolol: eraun ŋol eikorukus loka ari naka eŋalakimak.
Aŋolol naka Abalaŋ ŋes arai eikor lokokide, kiton osaŋe loka Yorodan, Ageunit eikor loka ari naka agolitomei kariri naka aŋolol kosane loka Yorodan;
Kitor eikor Bet-kogila, kiriria agolitomei naka Bet-araba; kitor eikor amoru naka Bokan okoku loka Reuben:
Kitor eikor Debir ageun kaditot naka Akor, ape agolitomei, kitei Giligal, loitei needokarere Adumim, loejai ari naka eŋalakimak naka ecor: kobe eikor akipi nuka En-semes, kosaŋak En-rogel;

Kitor eikor aditot naka okoku loka Kinom kiton ari naka eŋalakimak naka Eyebusit (nopenol ŋes Yerusalem): kitor eikor kuju keronat loejai kinaren kaditot naka Kinom kari nakoto, loejai atutubet nakosane naka aditot naka Repaim kari naka agolitomei:
Kigirunai eikor ageun kokuju keronat kiton atan naka akipi nuka Neputoa, kobe oreria luka emoru Epuron; kigirunai eikor kiton Baala (ŋopeŋol ŋes Kiriat-yearim):
Kokudo eikor koBaala ari nakoto kiton emoru Seir, kobe ari naka agolitomei naka emoru Yearim (nopenol ŋes Kesalon), kitor Bet-semes, kiriria Timuna:
Kobe eikorari naka agolitomei kowai loka Ekuron: kigirunai eikor kiton Sikeron, kobe emoru Baala, kosan Yabuneel; kosan eikor aŋolol.
Aŋolol nakapolon ŋes arai eikor loka ari nakoto, ka eikoruke. Ŋol ŋes eikor loalukunit idwe luka Yuda kwape ajaatar ikekiakee.

Abu koinak Kaleb okoku loka Yepune akorakinet kodwe luka Yuda, kwape ajaar aicorakinet naka EJAKAIT naeeorakinit ŋesi Yosua; akorakineteke ŋes Kiriat-araba, arai Araba ŋol papa loka Anak (nopenol ŋes Keburon).
Kirenea Kaleb odwe iuni luka Anak, Sesai, ka Akiman, ka Talimai, idwe luka Anak.
Koloma asurokin lueboiete koDebir: arai sek ekiror loka Debir Kiriat-seper.
Kotema Kaleb atiar, “Ŋol loedanyi luka Kiriat-seper, kosodi airum ere, akorakini eoŋ ŋol akokuka Akisa aimany.”
Kosodi Otiniel, okoku loka Kenas onace loka Kaleb, kirum ŋes; abu kokorak ŋes akokuke Akisa aimany.
Kosodi kanen, kebu mamake abu ŋin kokoto nol ailipun papake emanikor: kodok kasigiriake; kotema Kaleb ŋes atiar, “Inyo bo ikoto ijo?”
Kotema atiar, “Koinakinai eoŋ arereŋ; naarai kiinakinit eoŋ akwap naka ari naka Eijalakimak, koinakinai eoŋ da atanin nuka akipi.” Abu koinak ŋes atanin nukokuju ka nukajesa da.
Ŋin ŋes airumet naka ateker naka idwe luka Yuda kwape ejaatar ikekiakee.
Ireria lukosane luka ateker naka idwe luka Yuda kariri naka eikor loka Edom kari naka Eŋalakimak kes lu: Kabuseel, ka Eder ka Yagur;
ka Kina, ka Dimona, ka Adada;
ka Kedes, ka Kasor, ka Itinan;
ka Kasor-kadata, ka Keriot-kesiron (nopenol ŋes Kasor);
ka Kasar-gada, ka Kesimon, ka Bet-pelet;
ka Kasar-sual, ka Beer-seba, ka Bisiotia;
ka Baala, ka Iim, ka Esem;
ka Elitolad, ka Kesil, ka Korima;
ka Sikilag, ka Madumena, ka Sanisana;
ka Lebaot, ka Silikim, ka Ain, ka Rimon: ireria kere imwaasi akaisaarei ka lukanykaonon ka ireriakec ludidik.
Kapuuton, Esitaol, ka Sora, ka Asina;
ka Sanoa, ka En-ganim, ka Tapua, ka Enam;
ka Yaramut, ka Adulam, ka Soko, ka Aseka;
ka Saaraim, ka Aditaim, ka Gedera, ka Gederotaim; ireria itomon ka luoŋon ka ireriakee ludidik.
ka Dilan, ka Misipe, ka Yokiteel;
ka Kabon, ka Lakimam, ka Kitilis;
ka Gederot, ka Bet-dagon, ka Naama, ka Makeda; ireria itomon ka lukanykape ka ireriakee ludidik.
ka Iputa, ka Asina, ka Nesib;
ka Keila, ka Akisib, ka Maresa; ireria ikanykaoŋon ka ireriakee ludidik.
Ekuron, ka ireriake ka ireriake ludidik.
Ageun ka Ekuron kiton aŋolol, kere luedunyas ka Asudod, ka ireriakee ludidik.
Asudod, ireriake ka ireriake ludidik; Gasa, ireriake ka ireriake ludidik; kiton aguurut nako Misiri, ka aŋolol nakapolon, ka eikoruke.
Kakwap nakiukon, Samir, ka Yatir, ka Soko;
ka Dana, ka Kiriat-sana (nopenol ŋes Dabir);
ka Anab, ka Esitemo, ka Anim;
ka Gosen, ka Kolon, ka Gilo, ireria itomon ka lodiopet ka ireriakee ludidik.
ka Yanim ka Bet-tapua ka Apcka;
ka Kumita, ka Kiriat-araba, (nopenol ŋes Keburon), ka Sior; ireria ikanykaoŋon ka ireriakee ludidik.
Maon, ka Karamel, ka Sip, ka Yuta;
ka Yesereel, ka Yokodeam, ka Sanoa;
Kain, ka Gibea, ka Timuna; ireria itomon ka ireriakec ludidik.
ka Maarat, ka Bet-anot, ka Elitekon; ireria ikanykape ka ireriakec ludidik.
Kiriat-baal (nopenol ŋes Kiriat-yearim), ka Raba; ireria iarei ka ireriakec ludidik.
Kotoma amodiŋ, Bet-araba, Midin, ka Sekaka;
ka Nibisan, ka Ere loka Abalaŋ, ka En-gedi; ireria ikanykape ka ireriakee ludidik.
Konye Iyebusin, lueboienenete koYerusalem, mam idwe luka Yuda apotu kopedosi aireŋear kes: konye apotu Iyebusin kiboioto kidwe luka Yuda koYerusalem, kiton lolo.
